activity_summary: Master Thwaite said he would be brief, turned the glass twice, and was not brief. You did not count the halberds at the Mayor's pew. Sir John did not speak. Verbeke sat with the house because not to come would have been noticed, and nobody asked him where he is from. You took one number out of the church, and it was the two turnings.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Heard the two turnings and left the halberds uncounted.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Said he would be brief, turned the glass twice, and was not brief.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Waited him out and took the household home.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Sat, and did not count the sand.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Came with the house, and was not asked where he is from.

entities.name: Sir John Spencer
entities.context: Sat in his pew. He did not speak.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Nor I. Two turnings. That is the only number I am taking out of this church.
